title: 第7章 黄金一代第8章 藏功楼
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
镇东侯府深处。
一座气派，散发着特殊气韵的七层古塔中。
“基础刀法真的被改进了！”
七名气势不凡，头发发白的老者其实有的直接从座位上站了起来，有的不小心揪掉了自己的白胡须，有的将杯中茶水洒了出来，内心皆不平静。
基础刀法，顾名思义，那是用来铸就武道之基的，乃是根本法。
一个人的战力，未来潜力，与根本法那是有莫大的关系的。
所以，侯府基础刀法，乃是不外传之密，只有侯府嫡系和天赋出众，经过考验的旁门子弟才有资格修行这一刀法。
这款刀法乃是他们夏家长盛不衰600年的基石。
每一武道世家，都有独属于自己家族的根本法，全都是不传之秘，进行知识垄断，保证自身的长盛不衰。
而他们夏家的根本法，由始祖夏玄真所开创，后世家主族老等一代代修改，他们认为这一刀法早就达到至臻圆满了。
不会逊色于皇家基础刀法。
但现在竟然又有改进，还是一个小辈所达成的，他们如何能不吃惊。
可他们看着地面上那道带着炽烈之气的裂痕，刚刚夏辰已经当着他们的面施展了一遍，他们虽然嘴上反问，但内心早已相信。
之所以有如此大反应，只是觉得太不可思议了。
“好好好，你虽然武道天赋不行，没想到悟性却超群绝伦，论对族内的功勋，你比你父亲夏渊那小子还要大！”
为首一个头发花白的老头语气直接，大笑着说道，同时心中不由痛心疾首，上天何其不公啊，给了这孩子超群的悟性，但却没给他武道天赋，不然的话他们夏家又该出一位绝世妖孽！
他名叫夏宇，乃是镇东侯夏楚天的亲哥哥，夏潜夏渊的亲大伯，论起辈分来是夏辰的大爷爷。
夏楚天那一代兄弟八人，夏楚天排行老三，但因天赋最为出众，才智最高，当选了夏家家主，继承了镇东侯爵，而其余七位兄弟，年轻时也在军中任职。
36年前，大武和大奉爆发淮阳之战，夏楚天一战成神，最终主动归还兵权退出了军伍中，其他七位兄弟也陆陆续续交还兵权，回到侯府中担任族老，开始教导后辈子弟，提升家族底蕴……
“军功再多，那也不如你这一创法！”

又一老头跟着说道，乃是夏辰的五爷爷夏玄。
侯府600年辉煌，一代代将才辈出，300多年前，祖上因有大功再次受封安武侯，173年前，又得到一侯爵安东侯。
至此，夏家一门三侯爵。
所以对于他们来说，家族根本不缺军功。
而夏辰改良基础法，于家族而言，后代子弟，必将世代更加优秀，修为速度更加迅猛。
意义重大！
……
……
夏辰离开了功勋塔，说实话，这座功勋塔他也是第一次踏入，他的那几位爷爷辈族老，他也是17年来第一次见，但看他们的反应应该听说过夏辰废体大名。
“这次刷了一波存在感，对其生活在侯府中的地位有大益处，七位族老对我的感观都很好，用首阳破魔刀换取这些不亏！”
夏辰心中思索，至于对七位族老所说的他之名，能够写进族史中，死后搬进祖祠中，与族内史上诸多大才，一同享后人香火气运，夏辰倒是不在意。
他只求生前名！
身后名不是他现在该考虑的。
夏辰绕过蜿蜒曲折的后院，穿过演武场，演武场热火朝天，有五六岁的小孩跟随武师在练拳筑基，也有十一二岁少年在练枪，一柄长枪耍的寒光阵阵，阵势不凡。
还有少年举起千斤巨石，汗如雨下，但眼神中却透露着坚毅，坚持不懈。
“辰哥！”
content_en:
Deep in Zhendong Hou Mansion.
In a majestic seven-story ancient pagoda exuding a special charm.
"Basic knife skills have really been improved!"
Some of the seven imposing and white-haired old men actually stood up from their seats, some accidentally pulled out their white beards, and some spilled the tea in their cups, all feeling uneasy.
The basic sword technique, as the name suggests, is used to build the foundation of martial arts. It is the fundamental technique.
A person's combat power and future potential are closely related to his fundamental Dharma.
Therefore, the basic swordsmanship of the Hou Mansion is a secret that is not taught to outsiders. Only the direct descendants of the Hou Mansion and outstanding talents, and the tested disciples of the side sect are qualified to practice this swordsmanship.
This sword technique is the cornerstone of their Xia family's prosperity for 600 years.
Every martial arts family has its own fundamental method, all of which are secrets that are not passed down. They monopolize knowledge to ensure their own long-term prosperity.
The fundamental method of their Xia family was created by their ancestor Xia Xuanzhen and revised by generations of family heads and elders. They believed that this sword technique had reached perfection long ago.
It will not be inferior to the royal basic sword skills.
But now there is another improvement, achieved by a junior, how can they not be surprised.
But they looked at the fiery crack on the ground. Xia Chen had just performed it in front of them. Although they asked rhetorically, they already believed it in their hearts.
The reason why there was such a big reaction was just that it was incredible.
"Okay, okay, although you are not talented in martial arts, your understanding is unparalleled. In terms of achievements within the clan, you are greater than your father Xia Yuan!"
The leader, a gray-haired old man, said with a direct tone and laughed. At the same time, he couldn't help but feel sad in his heart. How unfair is God. He gave this child superior understanding, but did not give him martial arts talent. Otherwise, their Xia family would have produced another peerless evildoer!
His name is Xia Yu, he is the elder brother of Zhendong Hou Xia Chutian, the elder uncle of Xia Qian and Xia Yuan, and in terms of seniority, he is Xia Chen's eldest grandfather.
There were eight brothers in Xia Chutian's generation. Xia Chutian was the third eldest, but because of his most outstanding talent and intelligence, he was elected as the head of the Xia family and inherited the title of Marquis of Zhendong. The other seven brothers also served in the military when they were young.
36 years ago, the Battle of Huaiyang broke out between Dawu and Dafeng. Xia Chutian became a god in the battle, and finally voluntarily returned his military power and retired from the army. The other seven brothers also returned their military power one after another, returned to the Hou Mansion as clan elders, and began to teach the younger generations and improve the family heritage...
"No matter how many military achievements you have, they are still inferior to your invention!"
Another old man followed and said, it was Xia Chen's fifth grandfather, Xia Xuan.
The Marquis Mansion has been glorious for 600 years, with generations of generals and talents emerging. More than 300 years ago, my ancestor was awarded the title of Marquis Anwu again for his great achievements. 173 years ago, he was granted the title of Marquis Antong.
So far, the Xia family has three marquises.
So for them, the family does not lack military merit at all.
As for Xia Chen's improved basic method, as far as the family is concerned, future generations will definitely become better and faster from generation to generation.
It means a lot!
…
…
Xia Chen left the Merit Tower. To be honest, it was his first time to step into this Merit Tower. It was also the first time for him to meet his grandfathers and elders in 17 years, but judging from their reactions, he must have heard of Xia Chen's name.
"This time I gained a sense of presence, which is of great benefit to my status in the Marquis' Mansion. The seven clan elders all have a good impression of me. It's not a loss to exchange for these with the Shouyang Demon-Breaking Sword!"
Xia Chen thought in his heart, as for the seven clan elders saying that his name could be written into the clan's history, move into the ancestral temple after his death, and share the good fortune of future generations with many great talents in the clan's history, Xia Chen didn't care.
He only wants his first name in life!
His posthumous name is not something he should consider now.
Xia Chen walked around the winding backyard and passed through the martial arts field. The martial arts field was in full swing with five or six people.Children aged 11 to 12 are practicing boxing and building foundations with martial arts masters, and there are also teenagers aged 11 or 12 who are practicing spears. The long spears are showing off the cold light in an extraordinary formation.
There is also a young man lifting a huge boulder, sweating profusely, but his eyes reveal perseverance and perseverance.
"Brother Chen!"
